title: Q1
description:
Read: Num 12:6-8, Deu 18:15-19

One text sets vision and dream apart from speaking mouth to mouth. The other puts God's words in a prophet's mouth and requires the hearer's life of the one who will not hear.

a) Moses was already spoken with mouth to mouth. What, then, is the contrast between the prophets and the Son, if it is not that the older speech was unclear?

b) The hearer's life is already required of the one who refuses that prophet. What does the Son's speaking inherit from that requirement?
